text: Nexans SA is a listed company: its shares are quoted on Euronext Paris (Compartment A), ISIN FR0000044448, ticker NEX. As of 31 December 2025 the estimated distribution of its share capital was institutional investors 81.28% (including Invexans Limited 9.16%, Baillie Gifford 6.14% and Bpifrance Participations 5.20%), employees 3.90%, private investors 7.49%, treasury shares 0.14% and others 7.19%. Bpifrance Participations, represented by Karine Lenglart, sits on board committees made up of non-executive directors.
short: Nexans SA is listed on Euronext Paris; institutional investors hold 81.28%, Bpifrance Participations 5.20% with a board seat.
